title: Disambiguate the two save() functions

input.requestedOutcome: Rename the two identically-named `save()` functions in allotment_v2.html to intent-revealing names, update every call site file-wide, document why flSave() also persists BOATS, and describe the reload-survival test for a fleet-side boat status change (test/** is out of scope for this task's owned paths).
acceptanceCriteria: The closure-private cloud-sync save(v, forceLegacy) inside the boot IIFE (docs/workflows/07 §1.3) and the global persist helper save(area) that writes routes/boats/trips (docs/workflows/05 §10.1) are each renamed to an intent-revealing, non-colliding name.

Every call site of both renamed functions is updated file-wide; zero references to the bare old name `save(` remain outside the two known-unrelated locations (Canvas 2D `ctx.save()`/`c.save()` and the self-contained popup-window script string built by pjShotScript()).
Behavior is unchanged — this is a pure rename, not a refactor of what either function persists.
flSave()'s definition carries a comment explaining why it independently persists BOATS (fleet mutates b.log constantly and never calls the sales-side persist helper).
A test verifying a fleet-UI boat status change survives a reload is specified (test/** is not in this task's owned-files list, so the test itself could not be added in this run).
Verification includes node --check on the extracted <script> content and a grep proving zero old-name references remain.
constraints: allotment_v2/allotment_v2.html is explicitly pre-approved for this task by the user; do not hard-stop on it.
File is ~4MB — never read whole; grep -n to locate, read a 30-50 line window, targeted edit, re-read only the changed region.
Every JS change must be verified with node --check on the extracted <script> content.
Must rebase on sibling branches agent/LAM-27-cancelled-status-constant and agent/LAM-29-revert-to-seed-stores before editing, keeping both siblings' work.
Do not touch test/** (not owned this run).
Do not force-push; never commit to main or refactor/booking-v2-migration.
Stage only the three owned paths, never git add -A / git add .
assumptions: "the two save() functions" in the Jira title refers to the pair documented in docs/workflows/07-data-persistence-api.md §1.3 ("The two save() functions — a real trap"): the closure-private cloud-sync save(v, forceLegacy) at allotment_v2.html:219 (pre-rename) inside the boot IIFE, and the global persist helper save(area) at allotment_v2.html:5813 (pre-rename) that writes routes/boats/trips.

flSave() (the fleet-side persist helper) keeps its existing, already intent-revealing name; the Jira text about flSave() and BOATS (sourced from docs/workflows/05-fleet-management.md §10.1 item 1) is background/rationale for a documentation requirement at its definition, not an instruction to rename it — its name was already unambiguous and it is not part of the 'two save() functions' pair the doc identifies.

The reload-survival test (fleet UI boat status change → flSave() → BOATS persisted → reload → status still present) is a real, valuable test but test/** is outside this task's owned-files list, so it is declared as a dependency/follow-up rather than added.

output.summary: Renamed the closure-private cloud-sync save(v, forceLegacy) (inside the boot IIFE, allotment_v2.html) to _laSyncSave(v, forceLegacy), matching the file's existing _la*-prefixed private-helper convention in that IIFE, and renamed the global persist helper save(area) (writes ROUTES/BOATS/TRIPS to localStorage) to saveData(area), pairing it with its existing counterpart loadData(). Updated every real call site (6 for _laSyncSave, 44 for saveData, including 6 `typeof save==='function'` guards that the initial sweep missed and a follow-up pass fixed) and every comment that named the old identifier. Left three things deliberately untouched because they are unrelated identifiers that merely contain the substring "save(": Canvas 2D context calls `ctx.save()`/`c.save()` (2D drawing API, not our function), the self-contained `save(c)` function defined inside the string literal built by pjShotScript() (injected into an unrelated popup window, its own closure), and the local boolean parameter named `save` in `agTblCommit(save)` (unrelated). Added a documentation comment directly above flSave()'s definition explaining why it independently persists BOATS (fleet mutates b.log constantly and only ever calls flSave(), never saveData()), in addition to the pre-existing Thai §flBoatPersist comment inside the function body (updated in place to reference the new saveData() name). No behavior was changed anywhere — every edit is a pure identifier rename or a comment-text update to match.

behaviorChanges.before: Declared as `function save(v, forceLegacy)`, called from the localStorage.setItem shim, its own retry paths, and the unsaved-work recovery path — same bare name `save` as the unrelated global persist helper 3700+ lines later, and shadowed by nothing since it's closure-private.
behaviorChanges.after: Renamed to `_laSyncSave(v, forceLegacy)`, matching the file's existing `_la*`-prefixed private-helper convention (`_laSaveErr`, `_laBlobUsable`, `_laFlush`, `_laMark`, `_laShrinkBlocked`). All 5 call sites plus 1 comment mention updated. Identical logic — same XHR POST to /api/v1/_batch or /api/save, same retry/backoff behavior.

behaviorChanges.area: allotment_v2.html — global persist helper for ROUTES/BOATS/TRIPS
behaviorChanges.before: Declared as `function save(area)`, writing d.routes/d.boats/d.trips into the LS_KEY blob, gated by laCanEditArea(area). Called ~44 times across Boat Status, Boat Operation, Route/Season admin, and project-close code, plus mixed in with an unrelated closure-private function of the same name.
behaviorChanges.after: Renamed to `saveData(area)`, pairing it with its existing load-side counterpart `loadData()`. All ~44 call sites (including 6 `typeof save==='function'` guards found in a follow-up sweep) and 3 comment mentions updated. Identical logic — same laCanEditArea(area) gate, same read-modify-write of d.routes/d.boats/d.trips.

behaviorChanges.before: The rationale for flSave() also writing d.boats=BOATS lived only in a terse Thai comment (§flBoatPersist) inside the function body.
behaviorChanges.after: Added a 9-line English comment directly above the function definition (tagged LAM-31) spelling out: BOATS is a sales/schedule global that saveData() also owns; fleet code mutates b.log through flSave() call sites exclusively and never calls saveData(); saveData() is gated to Booking/Boat-Operation screens by laCanEditArea; removing d.boats=BOATS from flSave() would silently lose every fleet-side boat status edit on reload. The original Thai comment was left in place (with its save() reference updated to saveData()).

added: _laSyncSave(v, forceLegacy) — renamed from save(v, forceLegacy); closure-private inside the boot IIFE, not reachable from outside that scope.
saveData(area) — renamed from save(area); global function, same call signature and semantics as before.
removed: The bare global name save() no longer exists as either function; any external code or console snippet that referenced window.save (there were no such references in the file) would need updating to saveData().

details: Pure identifier rename. Neither function's write set changed: _laSyncSave still POSTs the same diff/ops payload to the same endpoints; saveData still writes d.routes/d.boats/d.trips (+ d.version) to the same LS_KEY blob under the same laCanEditArea(area) gate; flSave still writes the same fleet_* keys plus d.boats=BOATS.
No schema, migration, or API surface change.

decisions: Interpreted 'the two save() functions' (Jira title, matching docs/workflows/07-data-persistence-api.md §1.3's exact heading) as the closure-private cloud-sync save(v, forceLegacy) and the global persist helper save(area) — NOT flSave(). flSave() already had an intent-revealing, non-colliding name (fl-prefixed, fleet-scoped) and is a different function pair from the one the '07 §1.3' citation describes; the Jira text about flSave()/BOATS is sourced separately from docs/workflows/05-fleet-management.md §10.1 item 1 and reads as background/rationale for the documentation sub-requirement, not an instruction to rename flSave() itself.

Named the renamed cloud-sync function `_laSyncSave` to match the file's existing underscore+`la`-prefixed convention for closure-private helpers in that same boot IIFE (_laSaveErr, _laBlobUsable, _laFlush, _laMark, _laShrinkBlocked all already use this pattern).

Named the renamed global persist helper `saveData` to pair it with its existing load-side counterpart `loadData()` (declared immediately above it), which is the most direct, low-risk intent-revealing name available and requires no new abbreviation/prefix vocabulary.

Kept flSave()'s existing Thai §flBoatPersist in-body comment (only updating its save()->saveData() reference) and added a new, more complete English comment directly above the function definition — satisfying 'document, in a comment at flSave()'s new definition, why it owns BOATS' by treating 'new definition' as 'the definition site after this task's changes' rather than as evidence flSave() itself needed a new name.

Ran a first rename pass matching the literal `save(` call-syntax, then a mandatory follow-up pass after discovering it silently missed 6 `typeof save==='function'` type-checks (no parens immediately after the identifier) — both passes are reflected in the final diff and verification evidence above.
risks: This is a large, file-wide mechanical rename (48 real call sites + 2 definitions + comments) across a ~4MB single-file app with no automated test suite reachable in this sandbox (no Postgres, no prod service). node --check on every extracted <script> block is strong evidence the JS still parses, but it cannot prove runtime behavior is unchanged the way a browser smoke test or the declared reload test would.

Because saveData() and flSave() both write d.boats=BOATS by design (documented, pre-existing, unchanged by this task), a future edit to either could silently reintroduce ambiguity about which one 'owns' BOATS if the new comment at flSave() is not kept in sync.
dependencies: The reload-survival test could not be added because test/** is outside this task's owned-files list. Depends on a task/agent that owns test/** to add it.
followUps: Add an automated test (e.g. under test/e2e/ or test/unit/, following the LAM-22 harness pattern already in the repo — test/helpers/server.mjs, test/fixtures/booking.mjs) that: (1) loads the app with a fresh/seeded LS_KEY blob, (2) drives a fleet-UI boat status change (e.g. call saveStatus()/flSaveEditBoatStatus() equivalent flow, or directly push a new entry onto BOATS[i].log and call flSave()), (3) asserts localStorage[LS_KEY].boats reflects the new status immediately after flSave() runs (not after saveData()), (4) simulates a reload by re-reading and re-hydrating from localStorage (loadData()) and asserts the boat's current status (getCurStatus / last log entry) still matches. This directly exercises the §flBoatPersist / LAM-31 comment's claim and would regress loudly if a future refactor ever removed d.boats=BOATS from flSave() without adding an equivalent saveData() call on every fleet mutation path.

Consider whether _laSyncSave should eventually be exposed with a name discoverable via grep from outside the IIFE (e.g. in a code comment index) since it is currently only reachable by reading the boot IIFE end-to-end — out of scope for this pure-rename task.
rollback: Revert the single commit on this branch (or `git checkout <previous-commit> -- allotment_v2/allotment_v2.html`) to restore the original `save(v, forceLegacy)` / `save(area)` names. No data migration, schema, or persisted-blob shape changed, so rollback is a pure code revert with no cleanup required.
